info.title: winix
info.description: Cross-platform installer for the Winix CLI tool suite.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show commands that would be run without executing them

options.name: --project
options.description: Write into committed project files (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) instead of user/global agent config (agents only)

options.name: --claude
options.description: Force the Claude home/file even when absent: user scope → ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; --project → include CLAUDE.md (agents only)

options.name: --codex
options.description: Force the Codex user home (~/.codex/AGENTS.md) even when absent (agents user scope only)

options.name: --via
options.description: Package manager to use: winget, scoop, brew, dotnet

options.name: --path
options.description: Project directory for --project (agents only; default: current directory)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
